name: Wax cylinder, 1900
about: A voice cut into wax around 1900: narrow and honky, wobbling under a roar of hiss.

name: Worn-out wax cylinder
about: A cylinder played to death: frying crackle, heavy wobble and a voice almost lost in the roar.

name: Phonograph in the parlor
about: A cylinder machine playing across an old-fashioned sitting room, its little horn filling the space.

name: Gramophone 78
about: A shellac record on a wind-up gramophone: horn honk, gritty hiss and a scratch going round.

name: 78 played too fast
about: An early record on a machine cranked far too fast, so the voice comes out quick and chirpy.

name: 78 played too slow
about: The same old disc on a sluggish turntable: lower, slower and a little drowsy.

name: Wind-up gramophone running down
about: The spring gives out near the end and the voice sags slowly into a groan.

name: Little table gramophone
about: A small portable machine with a tiny horn: thin, nasal and crackling hard.

name: Electric 78 from the 1930s
about: A later electrical recording on a valve set: fuller and warmer, still hissing.

name: Skipping 78 record
about: A cracked old disc that jumps back a groove now and then and repeats itself.

name: Wire recorder, 1940s
about: A voice stored on spooled steel wire: narrow and honky, fluttering fast and hissing like steam.

name: Dusty vinyl LP
about: A long-player with dust in the grooves: soft crackle, pops and a low turntable rumble.

name: Warped record
about: A record left in the sun: the pitch swings up and down on every turn.

name: Suitcase record player
about: A 45 single on a cheap portable player with its own boxy little speaker in the lid.

name: Brand new pressing
about: A fresh record straight from the sleeve: warm and round, with only a faint tick or two.

name: Jukebox in a diner
about: A worn single booming out of the jukebox while cups clink and people chat at the counter.

name: Turntable losing power
about: Someone pulls the plug and the record groans down to a stop at the end.

name: Needle stuck in the groove
about: The needle sticks at the start of each phrase and repeats it before it jumps free.

name: Record at half speed
about: An album played at half its speed: a slow, sludgy giant with booming crackle.

name: Single at the wrong speed
about: A slow record played on the fast setting, so the voice squeaks along at a sprint.

name: Record sampled at 12 bits
about: A voice lifted off vinyl into an old 12-bit drum machine: crunchy, dusty and punchy.

name: Last groove before the label
about: The very end of a record side: the needle distorts on the tight inner groove, dull and spitting.

name: 1930s cabinet radio
about: A big wooden valve radio: warm and boomy, humming, a little static on the dial.

name: Radio by the fireplace
about: An evening talk on the family radio while logs crackle in the hearth.

name: 1940s wartime bulletin
about: An urgent news flash crackling out of a valve set, fading with the night signal.

name: 1940s newsreel in a theater
about: A punchy film narrator booming from the screen of a big old picture house.

name: 1940s radio drama
about: A spooky studio play with a twangy spring echo, heard on a big old set.

name: 1950s TV in the next room
about: A black and white set humming through the open doorway, warm and narrow.

name: 1980s TV through the wall
about: The neighbors' television murmuring through the wall, only the boom getting through.

name: TV signing off at night
about: The last words of the broadcast day, the high tube whine and snow taking over.

name: Home movie projector
about: A flickering family film with a thin, fluttering soundtrack in a dark living room.

name: Portable black and white TV
about: A little handle-top television on the counter, its speaker buzzing and whining.

name: Crystal radio, 1920s earphone
about: A homemade crystal set with no batteries: a faint, thin voice in one tinny earphone.

name: TV taped on a cassette recorder
about: A tape recorder held up to the TV speaker: the boxy set, the room around it and plenty of hiss.

name: Fresh cassette
about: A good chrome tape on a decent deck: soft, warm and only a whisper of hiss.

name: Worn-out cassette
about: A tape played a thousand times: dull, hissing, wobbling and full of little holes.

name: Mixtape, copy of a copy
about: A tape dubbed from a dub: twice the hiss, half the treble, two wobbles and a level that pumps.

name: Chewed-up cassette
about: A tape that got crinkled in the deck, so the pitch lurches wildly as it plays.

name: Tape player, dying batteries
about: A portable tape player on its last batteries: slow, sagging and seasick.

name: 8-track in a 1970s car
about: A thick, saturated cartridge tape playing through the dashboard as the car rolls along.

name: Reel-to-reel, recorded hot
about: A studio tape machine pushed into the red: thick, squashed and glowing.

name: Home reel-to-reel, slow speed
about: A family tape recorder on its slowest speed: dark, soft and gently drifting.

name: Pocket dictation recorder
about: A boss dictating a letter into a palm-sized tape recorder in a quiet office.

name: Classroom tape player
about: A worn lesson tape on the teacher's portable player, echoing round the classroom.

name: Recorder hidden in a pocket
about: A secret tape recorder buried in a coat: muffled, rustly and hissing.

name: Deck eating the tape
about: The deck tangles the tape mid-word: lurching pitch, holes and sudden slowdowns.

name: Boombox on the sidewalk
about: A tape blasting out of a portable stereo on a city stoop, traffic going by.

name: Tape left in a hot car
about: A cassette baked on the dashboard all summer: stretched, warbling and woozy.

name: Two tape machines flanging
about: The old studio trick of two tapes rubbing together: a slow jet-plane swoosh through your voice.

name: Camcorder at a birthday party
about: An old family video: the camera mic hearing the whole room and the chatter of the party.

name: Video tape on long play
about: A tape recorded at the slower speed to fit more in: duller, hissier, more wobbly.

name: Worn tape on extended play
about: The slowest speed on a tired old tape: murky, warbling and full of hiss.

name: Bad tracking
about: The heads wander off the track: bursts of noise, dropouts and pitch hiccups.

name: Rental tape played to death
about: The video shop copy everyone borrowed, humming on an old television speaker.

name: Wedding video in a church
about: A camcorder at the back of a stone church catching the vows and the echo.

name: Home video at the beach
about: Vacation footage by the sea: an open-air voice on tape and the surf rolling in.

name: Nature film on video tape
about: A hushed wildlife narrator on a borrowed tape, played in a dim living room.

name: Camcorder on a windy hill
about: Family footage from a snowy sledding hill, the wind buffeting the little camera mic.

name: Talking toy speech chip
about: A gritty 1980s toy chip with a buzzy edge, out of a coin-sized speaker.

name: Pull-string talking doll
about: The tiny record inside an old doll: fast when you pull the string, slowing as it unwinds.

name: Cheap sampled toy
about: A 1990s toy that plays a sample with no filtering, high sounds folding into metal.

name: Toy with dying batteries
about: A talking toy on flat batteries: the pitch sags and wavers on every loud word.

name: 1970s talking spelling toy
about: Your voice rebuilt by a learning toy's speech chip: buzzy, stepped and sing-song.

name: Spelling toy, batteries dying
about: The learning toy runs down while it talks, its voice sinking lower and rougher.

name: Speech chip in monotone
about: A speech chip reading on one flat note, every word the same buzzy pitch.

name: Whispering speech chip
about: The toy chip with its buzz switched off, so every word comes out as a gritty hiss.

name: Talking calculator
about: A pocket calculator reading out numbers in a high, crude chip voice from a tiny speaker.

name: Talking bear, tape inside
about: A stuffed bear with a cassette in its back, the speaker rattling under the fur.

name: Talking alarm clock
about: A bedside clock announcing the time in a crunchy chip voice over its own ticking.

name: Pocket pet toy
about: A keychain virtual pet chirping your words through a pinhole speaker.

name: 8-bit console, cheap sample
about: An 8-bit console sample squeezed to its lowest rate: fizzy, gritty and dull.

name: 8-bit console on the TV
about: The 8-bit sample chip played through a living-room television speaker.

name: 16-bit console, smooth
about: The soft, muffled sample sound of a 16-bit console, with its hardware echo behind.

name: 16-bit cave level
about: A 16-bit game voice in an underground stage, the console echo ringing long and dark.

name: 16-bit console, gritty
about: The rival 16-bit sound: raw 8-bit samples, crunchy edges and a ring of aliasing.

name: Handheld game
about: A 4-bit voice clip from a pocket game, buzzing out of its tiny speaker.

name: Handheld game, cheap clip
about: The handheld's voice clip at its crudest: fewer levels, lower rate, a coarse buzz.

name: 16-bit villain
about: The final boss of a 16-bit adventure: deep, huge and echoing from the console chip.

name: Tiny handheld hero
about: A brave little game hero squeaking out of a pocket console speaker.

name: Wise old sage in a game
about: An ancient village elder in an 8-bit adventure: shaky, slow and crunchy.

name: Early disc console cutscene
about: A dramatic 1990s game cutscene off a disc: grainy, roomy and a little over-acted.

name: Arcade voice chip
about: The gravelly sampled announcer of a 1980s arcade board.

name: Cabinet in a busy arcade
about: A machine shouting from its cabinet speaker while the whole arcade bleeps around you.

name: Arcade announcer, pushed hard
about: The arcade chip recorded too loud, so every word crunches and splats.

name: Fighting game announcer
about: A deep arcade voice calling the next round, echoing out of the cabinet.

name: Pinball machine voice
about: A crude speech chip barking from the backbox of a pinball table.

name: Fortune teller machine
about: A coin-op mystic at the fairground, a low chip voice in a twangy glass box.

name: Space shooter warning voice
about: A flat chip voice warning you of danger, bouncing echoes left and right.

name: Coin-op kiddie ride
about: The talking ride outside a supermarket: a cheery chip voice blaring from a cracked horn speaker.

name: Racing cabinet announcer
about: A driving game shouting from the seat speakers, its engine sample roaring under every word.

name: 8-bit home computer sampler
about: A home computer playing back an 8-bit sample on a bare converter, bright and buzzy.

name: 8-bit computer, cheap sampler
about: A bargain add-on sampler at its lowest rate: dull, buzzing and full of aliasing.

name: Computer beeper speaker
about: Speech forced out of a one-bit beeper inside an old office computer: harsh and fizzing.

name: 1980s computer reading aloud
about: A home computer's text reader buzzing your words on one robotic drone.

name: Early CD-ROM narrator
about: A boxy, grainy voice guiding you through a 1990s encyclopedia disc on desktop speakers.

name: Old 8-bit sound card
about: A voice clip at 11 kilohertz and 8 bits from an early computer game.

name: Dial-up modem robot
about: A voice squeezed down a dial-up line: buzzy robot tones and a crunchy screech.

name: Mainframe in the machine room
about: A room-sized computer droning its answers among roaring cooling fans.

name: Cheerful desktop helper
about: A perky little on-screen helper popping up with advice, squashed into a tiny file.

name: Early navigation voice
about: A first-generation car navigator telling you to turn, flat and grainy over the road noise.

name: Library computer, 1985
about: A talking program on the school library's computer, buzzing from its speaker in the hush.

name: MP3 from 1999
about: A music file squeezed small for dial-up: swirly, watery, ghostly before every t.

name: Tiny file for a slow modem
about: The smallest file you could download in a minute: bubbling, hollow and underwater.

name: Re-saved too many times
about: A clip converted and passed around until the damage piled up on itself.

name: Early internet video clip
about: A postage-stamp video from the early web, thin and swirly on laptop speakers.

name: Internet radio, buffering
about: A web radio host in 2001, the stream swirling and stalling into gaps.

name: Ringtone-era phone speaker
about: A clip played out loud on a 2005 phone: crunchy, tinny and rattling.

name: Old video call, 2005
about: A webcam chat from a bedroom: warbling, swirly and thin through laptop speakers.

name: Early game voice chat
about: A teammate on a cheap headset in a 2004 online match: hot, crushed and thin.

name: CD skipping on a bump
about: A portable disc player jolted on the bus: tiny scraps repeating in a rapid stutter.

name: Audiobook from a slow download
about: A spoken book crammed into the smallest file: narrow, hollow and a little watery.

name: Old internet cartoon voice
about: A squeaky character from an early web animation, grainy and squashed into a tiny file.

name: Streaming over dial-up
about: Live audio on a phone-line connection: bubbling, freezing and repeating scraps.
